metadata.title: Buist v. Anthropic: Hunt's 2023 government-pause paper, executed as a 2026 Sherman Act attack on lab-written pacing
metadata.frame: N.D. Cal. 3:26-cv-10693 (18 Sep 2026) names Anthropic, OpenAI OpCo, SpaceXAI, and Google for an alleged Sherman Act 1 agreement to slow frontier product improvement after Amodei's 12 Sep 'Pace the Frontier' essay and same-day public assents. Cheyenne Hunt co-authored Public Citizen's Apr 2023 'Sorry in Advance!' demanding a pause until government safeguards; she now calls the labs' public coordination a 'grift' and says rules must come from 'we the people.' That is the same anti-self-regulation line, not a flip. Encode AI and Guidelight midwifed the July employee letter the complaint treats as the conspiracy's machinery. No open-source payment from Coefficient Giving/EA to Hunt or TL4J; the filing attacks the waiver path Coefficient-world wanted legalized. Overlay.
metadata.grade: Docket, parties, Sep 12 public assents, July Pacing the Frontier letter, Hunt 2023 report, Hunt 19 Sep 2026 post, complaint para 7 'we the people' = FACT. Internally consistent Public Citizen project = STRONG. Encode/Guidelight upstream of predicate facts = FACT of organizing. Two-hop Hunt<->Encode via anti-self-reg coalition = ASSOCIATION. Coefficient/EA funded or directed the filing = UNSUPPORTED. 'EA cult ordered a villain lawsuit' = UNSUPPORTED (the filing burns EA's preferred private-coordination path).
metadata.honest_limits: Do not blob EA, Public Citizen, a16z, and ETH whales. Hunt's 2023 pause and 2026 suit target different authors of a slowdown (state vs labs). No 990 yet for Reckoning Action; donor absence is a fact, not a hidden Coefficient check. TESCREAL/longtermist-EV critiques are ideology-critique already in the elite-groups block; they are not a finding about this complaint's funding. Overlay; excluded from proofs.
metadata.method: PACER/RECAP complaint 3:26-cv-10693; Hunt X 2101104968715342062; Public Citizen Sorry in Advance (Claypool/Hunt, 18 Apr 2023); Reuters/Forbes on Pacing the Frontier + Encode AI + Guidelight; Politico/Bloomberg/CNN/TNW on the filing and the waiver sequence; existing Open Phil/EA wiring in catalog-nonprofits-foundations.

edges.notes: Hunt was Public Citizen's Big Tech Accountability Advocate and co-author (with Rick Claypool) of Sorry in Advance! (18 Apr 2023): 'Until meaningful government safeguards are in place to protect the public from the harms of generative A.I., we need a pause.' Explicit rejection of corporate self-regulation (fact of the report).

Named plaintiff in Buist v. Anthropic PBC, N.D. Cal. 3:26-cv-10693 (filed 18 Sep 2026), with Buist, Bullock, Spetsas, against Anthropic PBC, OpenAI OpCo LLC, SpaceXAI LLC, Google LLC. Sherman Act 1: alleged horizontal agreement to slow the rate competing frontier products improve, after Amodei's 12 Sep essay and same-day Musk/Altman/Hassabis assents. Hunt alleges paid subs to Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini. Complaint para 7: guardrails 'should not be decided by the Defendants, but by we the people, through state and federal regulation, and through the voices of juries.' Her 19 Sep post: industry-written rules are a 'grift.' Same 2023 Public Citizen line, antitrust venue (fact of docket + post).

Same complaint; Anthropic PBC is first-named defendant. Amodei's 12 Sep 'We Must Pace the Frontier' is the alleged offer; the July employee letter Amodei signed is recited as the 'no firm would slow alone' predicate (fact of docket).
Same complaint; Google LLC. Hassabis's July FINRA-style standards-body proposal and 12 Sep 'right path forward' are in the alleged acceptance (fact of docket).
Complaint names SpaceXAI LLC (Grok). Musk quote-posted Amodei within about an hour: 'Dario is right.' Hunt's post says she is suing 'X' (fact of docket + post; SpaceXAI aliases to xAI).

TL4J (Nick Rowley lead; Andrew Tutt; Stanton Jones; Jakob Norman) is counsel. Buist and Spetsas are Florida trial lawyers also named as plaintiffs - ordinary standing mix, not an AI-safety shop. Tutt is Yale/ex-DOJ OLC. Contingency PI economics, not a Coefficient grant (fact of caption; funding-of-counsel is not public).

Pacing the Frontier (28 Jul 2026), ~1178 employee signatories, organizational support from Encode AI and Guidelight AI Standards. Amodei signed; Anthropic endorsed as a company. Letter asks the US government to help build tools that could later coordinate a slowdown - 'build the brake, not pull it.' The complaint recites this statement as defendants recognizing that no firm would slow alone (fact of organizing + docket recitation).

Same July letter: Pachocki, Chen among signatories; OpenAI endorsed as a company and later said it helped shape the language. Encode is therefore upstream of the complaint's factual spine without being a defendant (fact).

Guidelight AI Standards (Page Hedley, Steven Adler - former OpenAI safety leads) co-supported the July letter and writes frontier safety standards meant to go beyond existing law. Professional AI-safety class, not a consumer PI shop. The complaint then treats the coordination those groups helped surface as the restraint of trade (fact of organizing; 'commissioned the suit' is NOT claimed).

ASSOCIATION not direction: Public Citizen (Hunt's former shop) and Encode sit in the same 'don't trust industry self-regulation / oppose federal preemption of state AI bills' civil-society cluster, overlapping Young People's Alliance and the Omidyar Responsible Tech Youth Power Fund neighborhood. Two-hop from Encode's July letter to Hunt's face on the Sep complaint. Not a payment (interpretation grounded in coalition space).

Coefficient Giving is the successor/rebrand of Open Philanthropy (announced 18 Nov 2025; Moskovitz/Tuna / Good Ventures still the anchor). Same shop, new name: still the dominant outside funder of AI-safety evaluators, alignment shops, and policy placement. Kept as a distinct node so the rebrand is visible on the graph rather than collapsed by alias (fact of rebrand).

GRADED ADJACENCY: Encode has been listed in the same grant neighborhood as Coefficient/Open Phil AI-governance grantees; Secure AI Project (Nick Beckstead, former Open Phil/Coefficient program officer, later FTX Future Fund) works the same state-bill circuit. Personnel hop (Howie Lempel alum) into Hunt's coalition space. This is NOT a finding that EA funded Hunt or TL4J. If anything, Buist v. Anthropic attacks the waiver/private-pacing path Coefficient-world wanted legalized (association; anti-capture cut).

INCENTIVE OVERLAP not payroll: David Sacks called a pacing waiver 'forming a cartel' before this complaint. The suit's Sherman theory is that sentence as a pleading; Hunt's press line is the opposite sermon (statutes, not an exemption). Same filing, two uses. No file ties a16z or Sacks to Hunt or TL4J (fact of Sacks's prior line; funding unsupported).

Alleged (and partly admitted-as-talks) coordination: July working group of company representatives on a standards body; 12 Sep public assents to Amodei's essay; Lehane 15 Sep confirmation of weeks of safety talks with Anthropic and DeepMind. Whether that is a Sherman 'agreement' is the live legal question - this edge records the public coordination the complaint recites, not a verdict (fact of public statements + OpenAI confirmation of talks; liability contested).
Tallinn (Skype co-founder) is the SFF/SFC funder. SFF-2025 recommended $34.33M, ~86% AI safety (fact of SFF announcements).

SFF-2025: Encode AI Corporation $516,000 general support from Jaan Tallinn (fact of SFF recommendations table). Encode's public rule bars funding from frontier-lab executives; Tallinn is an early Anthropic investor. Substance-over-form point, not a lie in Encode's sentence (fact of grant + investor status).

Encode lists FLI among foundation funders. FLI organized the Mar 2023 'pause GPT-4-scale training' letter Musk signed - a different pause (x-risk/longtermist) from Hunt's 2023 Public Citizen pause (government safeguards). Same noun, different authors (fact of Encode's funder page).

Tallinn is widely reported as an early Anthropic investor. That is why SFF money into Encode (organizer of the July letter Amodei signed) is a conflict-of-form for Encode's 'no frontier executives' rule even if Tallinn is not an Anthropic executive (fact of investor reporting; amount/date of his Anthropic stake not re-litigated here).
SFF Initiative Committee 2024: $700,000 general support to Longview Inc. Ltd from Tallinn (fact of SFF table).

Page Hedley (Guidelight CEO) was AI program director at Longview before co-founding Guidelight with Steven Adler (ex-OpenAI safety; still holds OpenAI equity). Longview is an EA donor-advisor (Natalie Cargill). This is the Coefficient-adjacent personnel hop into the July-letter organizer - biography, not a Guidelight 990 from Coefficient (fact of Guidelight team page).

Joint organizational support of Pacing the Frontier (28 Jul 2026). Guidelight writes standards meant to go beyond existing law; Encode does state/federal advocacy. Together they midwifed the predicate the complaint recites (fact of the letter's own attribution).

13 Sep 2026: Sacks (PCST chair; former WH AI czar) tells OpenAI/Anthropic to pace unilaterally and stop asking for a waiver 'so you can form a cartel.' Five days later the Buist complaint is that sentence as a pleading. Incentive overlap with Hunt's filing (kill private coordination) without a documented payment; Hunt's press line still demands statutes Sacks does not (fact of Sacks post; harvest not payroll).

GRADED: Longview has been described as funded primarily by Coefficient/Open Phil and has directed tens of millions in AIS grants; SFF's $700k is a second documented pipe. Not a finding that Coefficient funded Guidelight or Hunt (association via Hedley's prior job).
